answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 8063 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to have pets in your house? If so, what animals are permissible to have as pets? Question: Is it permissible to have pets in your house? If so, what animals are permissible to have as pets? Answer ID: 8063 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1043/1043=M/1429) (1) Yes, it is allowed. (2) One can keep cow, bull, buffalo , goat, camel, sheep etc and for riding and transportation donkey, horse etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
